evidence.name: Screen field: Style the bullet icons
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the bullet icons" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the bullet icons
sections.description: Styles the small icon or image on each bullet: how it sits in its box (fit shows the whole image, fill crops it to cover), how rounded the corners are, and the spacing around it, applied to all bullets at once. Keep icon size and shape consistent so the checklist looks tidy. The theme defaults are a safe start.
